activities.description: Chris Bockman asks questions about the meaning of AI in Zimbabwean policy and the advantages of AI. Jenfan Muswere answers, highlighting the focus on growth, transformation of economic policies, innovation, and inclusiveness in bridging the digital divide.

Chris Bockman asks about the effect of AI technology on developing countries within the context of the UN's 17 Sustainable Development Goals. Jenfan Muswere discusses AI's potential in addressing poverty, hunger, clean water, disaster management, industrialization, innovation, and infrastructure. Chris then inquires about Zimbabwe's potential as a key player in AI data gathering, to which Jenfan Muswere expresses optimism, emphasizing Zimbabwe's open approach to business and its ambition to become a leading ICT hub in Africa.
Chris Bockman concludes the interview, thanking Jenfan Muswere for his time.
